content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

This architecture is a complete digital commerce stack designed for creators who want to sell design assets such as ebooks, courses, and templates without relying on traditional payment processors. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, creators can have full control over their sales and data, ensuring they are not subject to high fees or platform restrictions. This approach matters because it empowers creators to operate independently and maintain their financial sovereignty, which is crucial in today's digital economy.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is built on a combination of free and low-cost tools that work seamlessly together. Hosting is provided by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, while the backend logic is managed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Order storage is handled through Supabase or Google Sheets, and product delivery is facilitated via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments are processed automatically via NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and has a minimal fee of just 0.5%, making it a cost-effective solution compared to alternatives like Gumroad.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are inaccessible. Whether you're a graphic designer selling templates, an educator offering online courses, or a musician distributing beats, this architecture provides the necessary tools to sell your products directly to customers. By leveraging crypto payments, you can bypass the high fees and limitations imposed by platforms like Gumroad, allowing you to retain more of your earnings and operate on your own terms.
Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments only takes 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The entire stack consists of several key components that work in harmony. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the hosting environment for your online store. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage the backend processes, ensuring smooth functionality. For order management, you can utilize Supabase or Google Sheets, offering an intuitive way to track sales. Product delivery is handled through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, while NOWPayments enables seamless crypto transactions. Together, these components form a robust framework for selling digital assets effectively.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first choose your hosting solution: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up your backend using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring that it is configured to handle orders. Next, select your order storage method, either Supabase or Google Sheets, and upload your products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing. By following these steps, you can establish your digital store quickly and efficiently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
At 100 sales per month, switching to NOWPayments retains $921 in your pocket.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook by setting up a digital commerce stack using free hosting like GitHub Pages and processing payments through NOWPayments. This allows you to operate independently from traditional platforms.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
The best way is to utilize a sovereign stack that combines free hosting, automated delivery, and low-cost payment processors like NOWPayments. This approach minimizes fees and maximizes your revenue.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, by using a custom digital commerce stack, you can sell templates and fonts directly. Implementing tools like Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments allows you to maintain control and reduce costs.
What are the advantages of using crypto payments for digital products?

Crypto payments offer lower transaction fees, faster processing times, and greater accessibility for international customers. This makes it a powerful option for digital creators looking to expand their market.
How can I ensure automated delivery of my digital products?
You can ensure automated delivery by using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file hosting, combined with backend scripts in Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage order fulfillment.
Full ownership of your commerce stack means no ongoing platform fees or restrictions.
